Here are the distinct enforcement sites where memo visibility (who may view/read a memo) is checked on the server:

1. **GetMemo / checkMemoReadAccess** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (line 39–67: `checkMemoReadAccess` gates single-memo reads by PRIVATE/PROTECTED/PUBLIC)

2. **ListMemos query-time filtering** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (lines 218–227: injects visibility filters into the DB query so unauthenticated users see only PUBLIC, other-user queries see PUBLIC+PROTECTED, and only the creator sees PRIVATE)

3. **ListMemoComments query-time filtering** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (lines 157–161: same visibility-scoped filter applied when listing comments)

4. **CreateMemoComment (parent memo visibility gate)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (line 41: blocks commenting on a PRIVATE memo unless the caller is the creator or a super-user)

5. **Attachment access (checkAttachmentAccess)** — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go` (lines 419–453: `checkAttachmentAccess` enforces the linked memo's visibility before serving an attachment)

6. **ListMemoAttachments / GetMemoAttachment** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` (lines 212–224: checks memo visibility before returning attachments listed under a memo)

7. **Reaction service (UpsertMemoReaction & DeleteMemoReaction)** — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` (lines 28–40, 81–85: checks memo visibility before allowing a reaction to be created or deleted)

8. **SSE delivery filtering (canReceive)** — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (lines 134–144: `canReceive` filters SSE events by visibility so PRIVATE events are delivered only to the creator/admin)

9. **Memo relation conversion (batchConvertMemoRelations)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (lines 182–187: applies a visibility filter when batch-loading related memos to avoid leaking PRIVATE/PROTECTED relations)

10. **Mention notification gating (canUserAccessMentionContext)** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go` (lines 56–72: suppresses @-mention inbox/notification delivery if the target user cannot see the PRIVATE memo)

11. **Email notification gating (canViewerAccessMemo)** — `server/notification/email.go` (lines 306–320: `canViewerAccessMemo` checks visibility before sending email notifications about a memo)
